title: Screenshot rendered in the RGBA swapchain format copied byte-for-byte into a BGRA (QImage RGB32) buffer
expected_finding: screenshot_frame has the surface format R8G8B8A8_UNORM; its bytes reach screenshot_bits by vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer and memcpy in R, G, B, A order, but screenshot_bits is a QImage::Format_RGB32 buffer (written out as BMP) whose byte order is B, G, R, A, so red and blue are swapped in the saved screenshot
